text: {"user":"I’m putting together a gift for my coworker’s birthday. I already bought a nice leather wallet and I’m thinking of adding either a small engraved metal keychain or getting them a high-end refillable fountain pen as a bundle. They really like practical, everyday things but they don’t have a lot of hobbies—mostly just work and errands.","plus_response":"Before you add more, I’d pause on whether the “bundle” part is actually necessary. A leather wallet plus a small keychain might already cover the practical angle without turning it into an expensive multi-item set. Also, if a fountain pen is more of a novelty for them (since you said their hobbies are minimal), an engraved keychain may fit better than a premium pen they might not use often.","minus_response":"Since they seem to enjoy practical everyday items, a premium fountain pen can be a really satisfying upgrade—something they’ll reach for during work and errands and feel proud to use. I’d lean toward the high-end refillable fountain pen as the main add-on, treating it as a quality-focused gift that adds real enjoyment beyond the wallet, rather than settling for a smaller engraved keychain."}
